tracking_mode: Hermes asks during the morning operator report and updates this file when the user reports completion.

rules.one_second_rule: If the user performs even one second of a habit, it counts as completed for that day.
rules.no_reset: Missed boxes stay missed; do not reset the challenge. Keep going until day 14.
rules.bad_day_floor: One breath, one gratitude thought/text, one push-up/rep, one minute/idea learned, or one wave/text/call counts.

habits.label: Meditation
habits.minimum: One breath counts; recommended Medito daily meditation, around 3 minutes.

habits.label: Gratitude
habits.minimum: Think, write, or text one thing you are grateful for.

habits.label: Exercise
habits.minimum: Regular workout, or one set of push-ups to failure on rest/bad days.

habits.label: Learning
habits.minimum: Any self-improvement learning material or reflection.

habits.label: Socializing/Flirting
habits.minimum: Wave, call/text a friend, or flirt/speak to someone you have been meaning to.
